# pritunl_host (Resource)

The host resource manages the settings of a Pritunl host. Hosts are born when the pritunl agent registers, never created by Terraform: this resource adopts the host by its `hostname` and manages its settings (the display name and the public address clients connect to). Destroying the resource only forgets it — the host itself is never removed.

An unset attribute keeps the value the host already carries: the public address stays auto-detected until it is configured, and configuring it is what pins the address clients connect to (the console's "Public Address" host setting).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pritunl_host" "gate" {
  hostname       = "silicon-1356"
  public_address = "gate.qa.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The machine hostname the host registered with; the adoption key.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The host's display name. Unset keeps the name the host already carries.
- `public_address` (String) The public address clients connect to. Unset keeps the address the host already carries (auto-detected when never configured).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
